text: くっくっく…　しらない　ほうが　みのためだぜ

structure.jp: しらない　ほうが　みのためだぜ

patterns.name: 〜ほうが
patterns.explanation: ほうが after a verb picks one choice out of two as the better one. しらない　ほうが = 'not knowing is the better way'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. みのためだぜ = 'it's for your own good, got it'.
